title: Cycle 1.1: The Pyroclave Ploy
name: The Pyroclave Ploy
intro: On the far side of the local dome, near the Broken Crown, an abandoned collapsed dome, lies the Pyroclave, a forgotten promethium cache that no gang currently claims. The tanks are old and the seals are weeping rust, but there is still fuel inside them, and in the underhive fuel is worth fighting over.

{t:The Midnight Theatre} know exactly what it is worth, and exactly who would want it. To the Cawdor, promethium is more than fuel. It feeds the braziers of their shrines and the sacred flames that burn away the unclean. So the Delaque let the rumour slip: a whisper in a drinking hole, a careless word overheard at a trading post. An unclaimed cache, out by the Broken Crown, there for the taking.

It reaches {p:The Carrion Psalm}, just as the Delaque meant it to. {@mordecai|Mordecai}, their Word Keeper, gathers his congregation and leads them out across the dome to claim it in the Emperor's name. In the ruins to the west, the Theatre are already waiting. The cache is the bait. The Psalm are the prey.

facts: Sniping Range: the winner of a roll-off picks a battlefield edge and their opponent takes the opposite one. Each gang deploys between its own edge and a line 12" from the centre line. On a 2' table that leaves just the edges, 24" apart.

King of the Hive: one objective sits at the centre of the battlefield. In the Check for Victory step of each End phase it scores 1 VP for the gang controlling it, and the first gang to 3 VP wins. If only one gang still has models on the battlefield, they win; if neither does, it is a draw.

{p:Protect the Future:} once both crews are deployed, one of your Prospects is picked at random (or a Ganger if there are none). If they are still on the battlefield when the battle ends, the side job is done.
{t:Crippling Strike:} if, in the Check for Victory step of any End phase, at least half of the enemy models on the battlefield are Seriously Injured or Engaged, the side job is done.

Strike Force: Both gangs use Custom (5)
{p:Psalm:} 6 fighters, 775 rating, including Ratsong as an extra Bonepicker from Without Number
{t:Theatre:} 5 fighters, 780 rating

photo.alt: The 2 foot by 2 foot mat dressed with gothic ruins, shipping containers, walkways and a raised circular platform near the middle.
photo.caption: The promethium cache known as the Pyroclave.

photo.alt: The six Carrion Psalm fighters in red and yellow robes, posed on the platform with Deus and Amen on the right.
The five Midnight Theatre fighters in long dark coats, posed on the platform among barrels and crates.

text: {p:The Carrion Psalm} approach from the east, through the ruined factory buildings and past an old promethium tank. {@mordecai|Mordecai} expects snipers covering the approach, but finds the ruined tower empty.

{t:The Midnight Theatre} lie in wait in the shadows of the old Gothic ruins to the west of the fuel cache. {@macavity|Macavity}'s not there. He's already slipped into the dark, flanking the Cawdor as they near, ready to strike From the Shadows.

map.label: Top-down map of the deployment on opposite table edges.

text: The silence is broken by the whir of plasma coils charging.

Seeing the glow behind a barricade directly ahead, {@mordecai|Mordecai} moves off to the left to stay out of the line of fire. He leaves {@deus-and-amen|Deus and Amen} to deal with the threat. {@ezekiel-crows|Ezekiel} takes the lead, advancing on the platform as the most likely location for the cache. He takes {@vermin-pyre|Vermin Pyre} with him: he'll know the good promethium cylinders when he sees them.
{@gutter-cantor|Gutter Cantor} is tasked with guiding the gang's newest prospect, {@ratsong|Ratsong}, and they move through the ruins to investigate the cargo containers.

Meanwhile {@rumpleteaser|Rumpleteaser} glances to {@jellylorum|Jellylorum} next to him and silently curses as he misjudges his shot and overcharges the plasma gun. He ducks back behind the barricade, cycling the coolant through the coils.
{@demeter|Demeter} and {@deuteronomy|Deuteronomy} move through the ruins to get into position.

rows.note: Note: Rumpleteaser uses Hip-shooting to rush to the barricade and fire on Mordecai. Unstable: the overcharge hits Rumpleteaser himself.

blocks.endsHead: Positions at the end of round 1

ends.alt: Two pairs of Delaque miniatures among the ruins, either side of the raised platform.
ends.caption: The Midnight Theatre lay the trap…

ends.alt: Cawdor miniatures advancing in two groups either side of a ruined tower, with Delaque miniatures in the distance beyond the platform.
ends.caption: …and the Carrion Psalm are drawn in like rats.

map.label: Top-down map of fighter positions at the end of round 1.

blocks.vp: End phase: nobody reached the Cache, so no VP. Score 0–0.

text: {@macavity|Macavity} stays out of sight, working his way round behind the Cawdor lines.
{@deus-and-amen|Deus} swings Amen round to face the barricade and opens up with the twin-linked stubber.

roll.name: Deus and Amen - Twin-linked Heavy Stubber

rows.note: Note: Bulging Biceps to move at Initiative and fire a heavy weapon. Twin-link allowed a re-roll of the Rapid Fire dice.

text: The rounds rattle off the barricade without finding a Delaque until the stubber jams.
When {@deus-and-amen|Deus}'s gun stops firing, {@jellylorum|Jellylorum} leans out from the barricade to cover {@rumpleteaser|Rumpleteaser} while he gets his plasma gun working again.

rows.note: Note: Juggernaut prevents suppression.

text: The las-bolt hits {@deus-and-amen|Amen} square in the chest, but the Stig-Shambler barely notices.
On the right flank, {@gutter-cantor|Gutter Cantor} and {@ratsong|Ratsong} push forward between the containers.
On the far side, {@demeter|Demeter} climbs into the Gothic ruin to find a sniper's perch. {@ezekiel-crows|Ezekiel Crows} spots him against the stonework and fires his autopistol.

roll.name: Ezekiel - Autopistol
roll.result: Demeter takes 1 wound and is suppressed

text: {@demeter|Demeter} ducks back behind the rubble, wounded. {@mordecai|Mordecai} and {@vermin-pyre|Vermin Pyre} reach the foot of the near ladder, ready to climb up and claim the Cache.
On the opposite side, {@deuteronomy|Deuteronomy} reaches the foot of the other ladder. Both gangs are now one climb away from the prize.

ports.alt: View past a blurred Deus and Amen, along the side of the central tower, to two Delaque miniatures behind a barricade.
ports.caption: Deus empties his twin heavy stubbers.

ports.alt: A Delaque sniper on top of the Gothic ruin, seen through the framework of the stairs.
ports.caption: Ezekiel spots the Delaque sniper.

blocks.endsHead: Positions at the end of round 2

map.label: Top-down map of fighter positions at the end of round 2.

blocks.vp: End phase: nobody reached the Cache, so no VP. Score 0–0.

text: With every Cawdor eye on the platform, {@macavity|Macavity} finally shows himself, stepping out of the shadows behind the Psalm's line.
{@deus-and-amen|Deus} clears the jam and turns the stubber back on the barricade.

roll.name: Deus and Amen - Twin-linked Heavy Stubber

rows.note: Note: Used Hidden Stash for a free reload action. Bulging Biceps to move at Initiative and fire a heavy weapon. Twin-linked to re-roll the Rapid Fire dice.

text: This time the burst finds {@rumpleteaser|Rumpleteaser}, and he slumps against the barricade. {@jellylorum|Jellylorum}, right beside him, holds his nerve.

rows.note: Rules note: I got this wrong. Nerve tests should only be taken when a friendly fighter is taken Out of Action, not Seriously Injured, so this test should not have happened.

text: {@macavity|Macavity} goes for the nearest Cawdor, but it's further than it looked from the shadows, and the charge falls short. He's left standing among the Psalm with nowhere to hide.

rows.note: Note: Used the Thunderous Charge tactic to roll 2D6 and pick one.

text: {@demeter|Demeter} is still pinned in the ruin and can't help him. {@ezekiel-crows|Ezekiel} turns and charges the Nacht-Ghul, cleaver raised.

rows.note: Initiative 3 +2 charge bonus
Note: Bull Charge for +1 Strength and Knockback (6+) on the charge.
Initiative 5

text: Both of them draw blood. {@mordecai|Mordecai} sees his chance to finish {@macavity|Macavity} off and charges in with his chainglaive.

rows.note: Initiative 5
Initiative 1 +2 charge bonus
Note: Unwieldy strikes at Initiative 1.

text: {@macavity|Macavity} is too quick for him. He twists away from the glaive and cuts {@mordecai|Mordecai} in return. Back at the barricade, {@jellylorum|Jellylorum} drags {@rumpleteaser|Rumpleteaser} back to his feet.

rows.note: Note: +1 die from the Tend Wounds action, +1 die from Jellylorum assisting.

text: {@gutter-cantor|Gutter Cantor} leaves {@ratsong|Ratsong} behind the containers and climbs onto their roof. From up there he can see {@deuteronomy|Deuteronomy} at the foot of the far ladder, and he opens fire.
{@jellylorum|Jellylorum} turns his lasgun on {@deus-and-amen|Deus and Amen}, but the Stig-Shambler shrugs off the hit.

rows.note: Note: Juggernaut prevents suppression.

text: {@deuteronomy|Deuteronomy} climbs the ladder anyway and stands at the edge of the platform. He reaches into the Warp to wrap himself in a Perfect Void, but the Warp bites back and he staggers.

rows.label: Perils
rows.result: Warp Surge! Suffers a S4 AP -2 L1 hit

rows.note: Rules note: I got this wrong. Deuteronomy should have taken a Maintain (Single) action for the Continuous Effect to persist after his activation.

text: On the other ladder, {@vermin-pyre|Vermin Pyre} reaches the top, levels his flamer across the platform at {@deuteronomy|Deuteronomy} and opens fire.

roll.name: Vermin Pyre - Flamer
roll.result: Deuteronomy takes 1 wound and is suppressed, Out of Ammo

rows.note: Note: Blaze (4+) causes an extra hit. +2 cover from Perfect Void.

text: The flames catch {@deuteronomy|Deuteronomy} and Vermin's tank runs dry. From the Gothic ruin, {@demeter|Demeter} finally gets a clear shot at the wounded {@ezekiel-crows|Ezekiel}.

ports.alt: Macavity at the very edge of the table, with the stairs and distant Cawdor fighters ahead of him.
ports.caption: Macavity emerges from the shadows.

ports.alt: Deus and Amen seen from behind, aiming the stubber past the central tower with Vermin Pyre beside him.
ports.caption: Deus takes down Rumpleteaser.

ends.alt: Close-up of Macavity and Ezekiel Crows fighting beside the barricade.
ends.caption: Macavity and Ezekiel Crows in combat.

blocks.endsHead: Positions at the end of round 3

photo.caption: The whole table at the end of round 3.

map.label: Top-down map of fighter positions at the end of round 3.

blocks.vp: End phase: the Psalm scored 1 VP at the Cache. Score 1–0 to the Psalm.

text: {@macavity|Macavity} doesn't wait for the Psalm to regroup. He turns from {@ezekiel-crows|Ezekiel} and goes for {@mordecai|Mordecai}, who is already bleeding from their last exchange.

rows.note: Initiative 5 +2 charge bonus
Note: Mordecai suffers the Personal Enmity lasting injury.

text: The fangs find their mark and the Word Keeper goes down. Losing their leader shakes the Psalm, but {@ezekiel-crows|Ezekiel}, wounded beside him, holds his ground.
{@deus-and-amen|Deus} wants revenge. He drags Amen round towards the Nacht-Ghul and fires the stubber.

roll.name: Deus and Amen - Twin-linked Heavy Stubber

rows.note: Note: Uses Bulging Biceps to move at Initiative and fire a heavy weapon.

text: Up in the Gothic ruin, {@demeter|Demeter} takes careful aim at {@ezekiel-crows|Ezekiel}.
{@ezekiel-crows|Ezekiel} goes down. On the platform, {@vermin-pyre|Vermin Pyre} slams a fresh canister into his flamer and turns it on {@deuteronomy|Deuteronomy} again.

roll.name: Vermin Pyre - Flamer
roll.result: Deuteronomy takes 1 wound and is suppressed

rows.note: Note: Blaze (4+) causes an extra hit. +2 cover from Perfect Void.

text: Burnt and pinned at the edge of the platform, {@deuteronomy|Deuteronomy} tries to keep hold of the Perfect Void.

roll.name: Deuteronomy - Maintain Power
roll.result: Deuteronomy takes 1 wound, is injured and suppressed

rows.label: Perils
rows.result: Warp Surge! Suffers a S4 AP -2 L1 hit

text: The Warp hits him again and he drops to his knees, but he still raises his flechette pistol and fires back at {@vermin-pyre|Vermin Pyre}.

rows.note: Note: Vermin Pyre suffers the Hobbled lasting injury.

text: The poison does its work and Vermin Pyre falls from the platform. Below it, {@ezekiel-crows|Ezekiel} crawls into cover and gets himself back up.

rows.note: Note: +1 die from the Tend Wounds action.

text: {@rumpleteaser|Rumpleteaser} is back in the fight. With {@deus-and-amen|Deus} busy with {@macavity|Macavity}, he fires his plasma gun at the Stig-Shambler.

roll.name: Rumpleteaser - Plasma Gun
roll.result: Deus and Amen take 2 wounds and are suppressed, weapon jammed

text: The bolt hits {@deus-and-amen|Deus and Amen} hard, but the heat of the shot has warped the coils out of alignment. The plasma gun can no longer hold a charge. {@gutter-cantor|Gutter Cantor} creeps to the edge of the container roof and fires down at {@rumpleteaser|Rumpleteaser}.
{@jellylorum|Jellylorum} fires back from the barricade, forcing {@gutter-cantor|Gutter Cantor} flat against the roof.
{@ratsong|Ratsong} darts between the containers to take a shot at {@jellylorum|Jellylorum}, but his stub gun doesn't have the range.

ends.alt: Macavity standing over the fallen Mordecai by the barricade, with Deus and Amen aiming in the foreground and Demeter on the Gothic ruin behind.
ends.caption: Mordecai falls to Macavity.

blocks.endsHead: Positions at the end of round 4

map.label: Top-down map of fighter positions at the end of round 4.

blocks.vp: End phase: the Psalm pass their bottle test and no VP is scored. Score 1–0 to the Psalm.

rounds.title: Round 5: An eye for an eye

text: {@macavity|Macavity} is wounded and right next to {@deus-and-amen|Deus}. Deus drives Amen into him, swinging the great club.

rows.note: Initiative 5
Initiative 1
Note: Unwieldy, so Initiative 1. No charge bonus to Initiative or attacks.

text: The club smashes {@macavity|Macavity} to the ground. {@demeter|Demeter} sees {@ezekiel-crows|Ezekiel} heading for the fallen Nacht-Ghul and fires to stop him.
{@ezekiel-crows|Ezekiel} keeps coming anyway. He reaches {@macavity|Macavity} and brings his cleaver down.

rows.note: Note: Macavity receives the Lesson Learnt lasting injury.

text: {@gutter-cantor|Gutter Cantor} empties his autogun at {@demeter|Demeter}, forcing him down, but runs out of ammunition.
{@jellylorum|Jellylorum} fires back at {@gutter-cantor|Gutter Cantor}, then heads for the foot of the ladder.
With his plasma gun useless, {@rumpleteaser|Rumpleteaser} falls back into the shadows.
{@ratsong|Ratsong} makes his way back towards the platform ladder.
{@deuteronomy|Deuteronomy} gathers what strength he has left and walks to the centre of the platform. He stands over the Cache, and for now it's his.

ends.alt: Macavity tipped over at the barricade beside Deus and Amen.
ends.caption: Macavity goes down.

blocks.endsHead: Positions at the end of round 5

map.label: Top-down map of fighter positions at the end of round 5.

blocks.vp: End phase: the Theatre scored 1 VP at the Cache. Score 1–1.

text: {@deus-and-amen|Deus and Amen} move up and fire at {@demeter|Demeter}'s position in the ruin.

roll.name: Deus and Amen - Twin-linked Heavy Stubber

rows.note: Note: Bulging Biceps to move at Initiative and fire a heavy weapon.

text: {@demeter|Demeter} fires back at {@deus-and-amen|Deus}, but the shot only glances off Amen.

rows.note: Note: Juggernaut prevents becoming suppressed.

text: {@ezekiel-crows|Ezekiel} limps to the foot of the ladder, with {@deuteronomy|Deuteronomy} standing at the top.
{@jellylorum|Jellylorum} climbs up to his leader and patches up his worst wound so {@deuteronomy|Deuteronomy} can stand again.
{@gutter-cantor|Gutter Cantor} reloads his autogun.
{@rumpleteaser|Rumpleteaser} stays in the shadows, his plasma gun still unable to hold a charge.
{@ratsong|Ratsong} reaches the bottom of the ladder and takes a hopeful shot at {@demeter|Demeter}.

blocks.endsHead: Positions at the end of round 6

map.label: Top-down map of fighter positions at the end of round 6.

blocks.vp: End phase: the Theatre scored 1 VP at the Cache. Score 2–1 to the Theatre.

text: {@demeter|Demeter} has had enough of {@gutter-cantor|Gutter Cantor} on the container roof and takes careful aim.
{@deus-and-amen|Deus and Amen} fire back at {@demeter|Demeter}, but miss again.

roll.name: Deus and Amen - Twin-linked Heavy Stubber

text: {@jellylorum|Jellylorum} moves to fire on {@gutter-cantor|Gutter Cantor} as well.
{@ezekiel-crows|Ezekiel} climbs to the top of the ladder and fires at the Delaque on the platform.
{@deuteronomy|Deuteronomy} barely looks at him. He raises his flechette pistol and fires back.
Wounded on the container roof, {@gutter-cantor|Gutter Cantor} fires one last burst at {@demeter|Demeter}.
{@rumpleteaser|Rumpleteaser} stays in the shadows. The Theatre already have what they came for.

{@ratsong|Ratsong} waits at the bottom of the ladder, unable to get past {@ezekiel-crows|Ezekiel} at the top. Up on the platform, {t:The Midnight Theatre} still hold the Cache, and the Psalm have run out of time.

blocks.endsHead: Positions at the end of round 7

map.label: Top-down map of fighter positions at the end of round 7.

blocks.vp: End phase: the Theatre scored 1 VP at the Cache. Final score 3–1 to the Theatre.

aftermath.result: {t:The Midnight Theatre} take the promethium cache

prose: When the shooting stops, {@deuteronomy|Deuteronomy} is still standing over the Cache, and the Pyroclave belongs to the Theatre. The Psalm carry their wounded back east. {@mordecai|Mordecai} survives {@macavity|Macavity}'s fangs, but he comes away with a burning hatred for the Nacht-Ghul. {@vermin-pyre|Vermin Pyre} is left Hobbled by his fall from the platform. Macavity was cut down by {@ezekiel-crows|Ezekiel}'s cleaver, but he recovers and is wiser for it. The Psalm leave convinced that the promethium should have been theirs.

photo.caption: The end of the battle, with Deuteronomy holding the Cache.
